policies.title: Taiwan ordinary passports: Solomon Islands advance visa
policies.summary: Taiwan's current consular guidance says Solomon Islands cancelled visa on arrival for Taiwan passports and requires a visa application before travel.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Taiwan passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
Taiwan's consular page says Solomon Islands cancelled visa on arrival on 24 April 2025, so the visa must be obtained before travel.
Taiwan and Solomon Islands have no offices in each other's territory; the guidance warns that application can be difficult and suggests an agent or a nearby Solomon Islands mission.
Work, residence, transit, special documents, carrier checks and final admission remain outside scope.

application.label: Taiwan BOCA Solomon Islands entry guidance
steps: Contact a Solomon Islands mission in a nearby country or a qualified travel agent before travel.
Obtain the visitor visa before departure; visa on arrival is no longer available to Taiwan passports.
Carry the issued visa and supporting documents for carrier and final-admission checks.
